headline: Contract with Boston Carting Services LLC for 60 months of municipal solid waste, recycling, and yard waste hauling; $72,824.03 for two special elections.
summary: The committee will review requests to appropriate $100,000 for Local Cultural Council grants, $72,824.03 for special elections, and a $545,649 budget transfer for Public Health accounts. It will also review a 60-month hauling contract and a communication on a homeland security plan.
items: Appropriate $100,000 from the Encore Artist and Cultural Support Stabilization Fund for Local Cultural Council grants to artists, organizations, and schools
Supplemental appropriation of $72,824.03 to various Election Department accounts to fund the two special elections
Pay prior year invoices totaling $12,844.97 from Health and Human Services-Administration Ordinary Maintenance Account funds for Medicaid billing and collection services
Transfer $545,649 from Infrastructure: Inspectional Services Salaries to Health and Human Services: Public Health Personal Services accounts to correct a Fiscal Year 2027 budget allocation error
60-month contract with Boston Carting Services LLC for hauling municipal solid waste, recycling, and yard waste
Communication from Councilor Wheeler sharing the Metro Boston Homeland Security Region's Urban Area Security Initiative fiscal year 2024 plan and allocations
